In 2024, the sacrifices and the offerings stopped.
Because of the attack launched by Hamas,
the Israeli government ordered that year's Passover sacrifice to be cancelled;
it was only held the following year, in 2025.
This corresponds exactly to Daniel 11:31:
"Forces will stand on his part, and they will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress,
and will take away the continual burnt offering.
Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate."
And whether you believe it or not,
what is coming will definitely happen.
The dates are worked out from the Word and from events:
mid-November 2026 to the end of February — the first.
the end of February 2027 to the end of June — the second.
the end of June 2027 to the beginning of October — the last.
Next come the beast's mark,
the beast's name, and the beast's number.
First, the controlled drugs in the pandemic.
You have to accept them; only then do you get a health code,
just like the pass that was sealed in ancient times.
Having it stamped, sealed, is the mark.
1st, the beast's mark.
There are many who will contradict, because they refuse to admit it.
Eternal life as if already half dead, but there is one more chance.
Second, the controlled drugs of the second pandemic
carry the beast's name as well:
it may be luciferase,
it may be some other packaging, but they all point the same way.
Second, the beast's name.
The hope is plain: that time will be your last.
You may refuse to believe, but you will pay with your eternal life for a stubborn heart.
Third, from the second phase to the last:
the beast's number.
The final hurdle: 666.
You all know, this will be when digital currency goes global.
If you do not accept, you will not be able to buy or sell.
If you accept, you will not be able to enter the Kingdom of Heaven.
So, let us all stay alert and keep our garments.
You all know the numbers: 40 is testing, 50 is the jubilee.
The fortieth jubilee after Christ was baptized — 2000 years later —
is the trumpet feast of 2027.
The Lord is coming soon,
no longer just a slogan.
It is already a very clear goal for us.
Next year, the trumpet feast —
the Lord is coming soon.
